changelog:
- Fokk Relay (Private Relay Architecture): Renamed and refined into Apple-style 'Fokk Relay' with dedicated modern vector iconography and zero-maintenance automation.
- Automated GitHub Actions Sentinel: 100% maintenance-free architecture that scans, verifies TLS transparency, and updates country exit nodes automatically without app updates.
- Strict Zero-Leak Killswitch: Removed silent direct fallback from WebView ProxyConfig, guaranteeing zero IP leaks so ip checking sites always see the dedicated country exit IP.
- Verified Live Country Nodes: High-speed, transparent TLS egress nodes across US, UK, DE, NL, CA, JP, KR, SG, HK, and IN.
- Command Card Clean-up: Permanently removed minimize screen and dual screen buttons above and on the command card bar for an ultra-clean browsing experience.
- Premium UI Preservation: Maintained all 11 circular vector flag avatars and Opera-style dark theme bottom sheets.
